questions.question: How do you negotiate project timelines when stakeholders demand earlier completion dates?
questions.ideal_answer: Acknowledge the stakeholder's business drivers first. Present clear trade-off choices using the iron triangle (Scope, Cost/Resources, Time). Propose phased delivery where high-value features launch early, followed by iterative releases, ensuring quality is not compromised.
key_points: Demonstrates empathy for business drivers and deadlines
Uses the Iron Triangle (Time, Scope, Quality/Cost) to explain trade-offs
Offers creative solutions like phased delivery or scope reduction
Protects technical quality and avoids burnout
Secures formal alignment on agreed scope
